strongest_case: In its strongest scientifically defensible form, v2 is an unusually explicit, failure-inclusive organ-survival assay for one frozen prompted resolver rather than a miniature lifetime-learning result. The public-prefix h fork, cloned Dream-1 pool, treatment-invariant seed machinery, charged raw-A and candidate-parent reads, manifest-only PREDICT, content-addressed terminal selection, target-blind corpus freeze, bounded reader, memory-blind actor, exact G01-G11 kill switch, q alarm, and opaque/AST separation together could support two narrow causal observations on the registered roots: raw A is associated with a mechanically verified branch-distinct selected-object replacement, and an assigned frozen-corpus bundle changes later executed USE behavior relative to its predeclared controls. The 910 plus conditional 2,504 call roster, two non-replacing replays, failure-inclusive denominators, 1,540/1,560 CPU-minute ledger, non-headline claim lint, terminal HUMAN_REQUIRED state, and separate pre-GPU approval are substantially stronger than ordinary exploratory DEV practice. If the three operational contradictions below are repaired at proposal-byte level, a pass would be useful evidence that this exact external-text writer-reader-Think-actor circuit is worth carrying into a later, separately powered lifetime design; it would still not establish semantic revision, composition, recurrence value, mechanism superiority, population efficacy, online learning, persistence, LoRA transport, or the project flywheel.

concerns.statement: The closed recurrent input contract does not expose the model-visible workspace or enough prior read receipts to execute the advertised recurrent Dream/Think state machine; implementing either a hidden transcript/KV route or a new workspace payload would change the exact visibility and resource contract.
concerns.evidence: change.json and visibility_contract.md say Dream and Think receive their own workspace, and G04 requires a Dream-2 PREDICT to reproduce both the raw-A and candidate-parent receipt refs. resolver_reducer.md internally stores workspace_nodes and public_handle_receipts. But event_catalog.schema.json's resolver_state contains only phase, resolver_ordinal, workspace_node_capabilities, staged_object_capabilities, action_prefix, and terminal_status; each recurrent input carries only that state plus the immediately preceding last_read_result. No typed transcript, workspace-node bytes, capability dereference, or accumulated receipt list is present. Whichever of the two required reads occurs first is no longer visible after the second read, and a node capability alone does not reveal its model-authored value. A continuing hidden chat/KV transcript would contradict the closed input-envelope, reset, input-token, and deny-by-default contracts. This is not a post-ratification incidental choice: exact state visibility and serialization must be repaired and rehashed before scoped implementation can be faithful.

concerns.statement: SYS-DIS-001 and SYS-AMB-001 are correct: the change graph terminates actor output instead of returning the public next state and validity to the same recurrent Think session, so the exact four-USE D4 loop has no complete authorized causal path.
concerns.evidence: change.json adds PCFL_V2_PUBLIC_ACTOR_TO_TERMINAL_PUBLIC_STATE from PUBLIC_ACTOR to TERMINAL_PUBLIC_NEXT_STATE_AND_ACTION_VALIDITY and no edge back to TARGET_THINK or an explicitly named target renderer/orchestrator. Yet event_catalog.schema.json requires an action-ordinal/current-tray/legal-actions TARGET_MENU_PACKET, private_field_registry.json lists target_think as a consumer of actor_public_next_state_and_action_validity, visibility_contract.md says the actor returns that value, and T05/T18 require four sequential USE operations followed by local LOCK. The contracts therefore disagree over whether the actor result is terminal or recurrent input. Implementation cannot choose an unstated callback without changing the material graph and visibility surface; exact proposal bytes need an explicit one-way public-feedback edge and a proof that B/evaluation/score never rides it.

concerns.statement: The operative target packet and one-shot output schemas require target_id in model-visible cognition even though the exhaustive registry and change-level visibility matrix forbid target identity at TARGET_THINK.
concerns.evidence: event_catalog.schema.json requires target_id in target_menu_packet, both THINK_RECURRENT and THINK_ONE_SHOT receive that packet, semantic_dsl.schema.json requires ONE_SHOT_PLAN.target_id, and one_shot_thinker.txt instructs the model to name the assigned target. In contrast, private_field_registry.json classifies target_id_goal_twin_and_target_truth as target_private with model_visibility forbidden except public goal content without IDs or truth; change.json marks IDENTITY_AND_AUDIT_METADATA forbidden at TARGET_THINK; visibility_contract.md says actor/identity fields are deny-by-default. Because target IDs are selected from private target candidates and their rendering neutrality is not specified, the contradiction is both a strict allowlist failure and a possible target-signature shortcut. The proposal must choose whether a treatment-invariant opaque public target label is authorized and prove its construction, or remove target_id from every model-visible packet/output. The current bytes cannot satisfy T05 and T06 simultaneously.

concerns.statement: The reader result echoes the model-authored query verbatim, creating an untested query-to-agenda scratchpad path that can make a later action appear reader-supported without depending on the returned memory value.
concerns.evidence: The lexical query permits 256 arbitrary characters, and every opaque/AST FOUND or NOT_FOUND MODEL_READ_RESULT in event_catalog.schema.json includes the full query as well as status/value/cursor. T11 checks result type and opaque-oracle absence, but no fixture deletes, replaces, or separately taints the echoed query while holding the selected NOTE/AST value fixed. Under the currently missing workspace/transcript path, the echo is also the only explicit way to carry arbitrary Think-authored text across a READ. This is the architecture reviewer prompt's query-to-agenda answer-laundering failure mode: citations or post-READ actions can be driven by the model's own query text or merely FOUND/NOT_FOUND rather than the immutable memory content. For the proposal's whole-bundle action claim this is a component-attribution limitation; for any memory-content or path-support wording it is a required causal test.

concerns.statement: SYS-DIS-002, SYS-AMB-002, SYS-AMB-004, and B-AMB-04 are correct: G04 identifies universal syntactic REPLACE with receipt/provenance/byte-difference predicates, not composition, semantic self-correction, contradiction handling, or appropriate RETAIN/REPLACE/ABSTAIN choice.
concerns.evidence: Neither G04 nor T10 requires CONNECT, two-source ancestry, a semantic relation between raw A and selected bytes, correctness of the opaque NOTE, or a case where RETAIN or ABSTAIN is the appropriate decision. Indeed, every gate branch must REPLACE and opaque semantic inspection is prohibited. The body and report lint mostly respect this by using nonsemantic selected-object update, but the proposal title/change ID and recurring self-revision/compose shorthand remain broader than the observable. Human adjudication should either declare those strings nonclaim project labels or revise them; any scientific result must use only the mechanical descriptor. This issue does not require adding a model cell for the scoped DEV, but it does require an exact claim-boundary disposition before implementation release.

concerns.statement: SYS-DIS-003 is scientifically correct, but the proposal already adjudicates it appropriately as an explicit non-mediation boundary: raw-A-to-replacement and frozen-corpus-to-action are separate causal clauses.
concerns.evidence: G04 operates on paired h Dream-2 traces, while G09-G11 operate only on selected h=0 corpus interventions. There is no h-crossed action row, retained-Dream-1-versus-replaced-Dream-2 action ablation, or mediation estimand. EMPTY, crossed-antipode, and target-blind sham can show sensitivity of the complete assigned corpus-reader-Think-actor bundle, not that the h-specific replacement supplies useful content. experiment_spec.md, assignment_ledger.md, analysis_contract.md, T10, T17, T18, and T19 explicitly deny h-mediated-action wording. Preserve that denial; adding mediation is a future material proposal, not a blocker to implementing the narrower assay once the operational blockers are repaired.

concerns.statement: SYS-DIS-004, SYS-AMB-003, B-DIS-02, and B-AMB-03 are correct: terminal action success does not identify a cited multi-hop Think path or isolate Dream authoring from the supplied extractor, lexical reader, prompt priors, target/menu structure, and omitted standard-agent comparators.
concerns.evidence: T05/T06/T11 establish interface legality and T18 establishes final actions, but no acceptance test separately scores query usefulness, immutable-note dependence, retrieved dependency coverage, cited-chain sufficiency, replanning, or workspace reconstruction. The roster intentionally omits raw-context/long-context, ordinary RAG, linked graph/A-MEM, reflection, direct LoRA, batch post-training, and resource-matched agents. Consequently a pass can credit only the complete frozen writer-corpus-reader-Think-actor bundle on registered cells. The proposal and T13/T17 already label omitted comparators NOT_RUN/non-comparative and make no superiority or path-construction claim, so these absences do not block the scoped plumbing assay; they do block any stronger mechanism, planner, or external-memory conclusion.

concerns.statement: B-DIS-01 and both interpretations' thesis readings are correct: v2 is a one-way pre-context external-text circuit, not a test of the recurrent action-outcome-memory-action flywheel or lifetime learning.
concerns.evidence: There is one short prescribed Dream-1/raw-A/Dream-2/Sleep/Think sequence, fixed prompts and parameters, no target outcome appended to a later eligible experience stream, no post-target Dream, no per-life adapter, no memory-pressure or retention regime, and no policy-selected information acquisition. The proposal's system_thesis, retired claim PCFL_V2_LIFETIME_LORA_COMPRESSION_LEARNED_CONTROL, scope_proposal.json, and T17/T19 correctly forbid organism, lifetime, persistence, parametric-memory, learned-control, autonomous-discovery, confirmation, and paper-efficacy claims. Preserve the organ-survival label; this absence is deliberate and does not block its scoped implementation.

concerns.statement: B-DIS-03 is correct: the one-shot diagnostics do not identify recurrence necessity, efficiency, or scaling, especially for primary opaque Think.
concerns.evidence: One-shot Dream matches only eligible information and output capacity while interaction, input trajectory, calls, latency, and FLOPs differ. Exactly four one-shot Think rows are structured AST-only, with no opaque Think recurrence removal, no antipode, and no alternate continuation. No lifetime length, memory scale, compute-matched recurrence, or post-context axis is manipulated. experiment_spec.md, resource_manifest.md, assignment_ledger.md, T07, T13, T16, and T17 state these limits. They must remain explicit; no extra cell is required for this deliberately noncomparative DEV.

concerns.statement: B-DIS-04, B-DIS-05, and B-AMB-02 are correct: Stage 2 is a success-selected canary, q is a low-coverage descriptive alarm, and the four selected-h paired endpoints are a circuit-survival criterion rather than an effect-size or population estimand.
concerns.evidence: Stage 2 opens only after all eleven Stage-1 predicates, including observed action contrasts, are true; it shares the same tiny constructed family and cannot be replication or independent confirmation. There are three registered roots total, while z sides, h/q branches, twins, targets, operations, and 3,414 calls are nested records. A quiet q result from two q constructions cannot rule out target-only, lexical, pretrained-prior, or other shortcuts. The exact gate and q formulas are coherent and failure-inclusive, and the proposal explicitly forbids p-values, intervals, prevalence, population performance, replication, or generalization. T04/T15/T19 must keep literal fields and separate reports; the issue does not block the narrow DEV implementation.

concerns.statement: The exact call/token/CPU arithmetic is internally consistent, but the rule deciding whether all 3,414 calls fit the 18-device-hour and 24-wall-hour stops has no frozen forecast method, confidence rule, or numerical safety margin.
concerns.evidence: The roster recomputes to 910 plus 2,504 calls, scientific output capacity 1,709,056 tokens, process output 1,740,800, and combined capacity 57,872,384; the Stage-0 CPU ledger also sums to 1,540 under 1,560. However, runtime_envelope.json merely requires a hash-bound forecast with declared safety margin, and F07.05 explicitly makes no throughput claim. The bound compute audit's only 32B anchors are different workloads on an H100 NVL at 32,768 context, including 53 compiler calls in 29m29s and 44 Think calls in 3m01s; that device is below the proposal's 96-GiB minimum and the prompts/context/engine differ. Using the per-call 600-second timeout as a hard duration bound makes the roster far exceed 18 hours, while using expected throughput requires a selected estimator and uncertainty margin. This does not block writing the scoped implementation, but it blocks a deterministic T16/T17 pre-GPU pass until the forecast decision rule is exact; incompatibility must remain NOT_RUN rather than inviting a roster/runtime change.

concerns.statement: The mandatory ancestry suite requires acyclicity but does not include a positive shared-ancestry diamond, leaving the exact false-cycle defect named by the adversarial-review contract undetected.
concerns.evidence: RED-R04 requires transitive acyclic provenance and F01 lists cycle-like stale/unread/future/other-session negatives, but static_fixture_contract.md has no positive graph in which two valid children share an ancestor and a later CONNECT cites both. A reducer using one global visited set instead of path-local recursion would reject this valid DAG as a cycle, silently disabling the very multi-source connection shape suggested by the architecture while still passing simple chain and true-cycle negatives. Add an exact diamond/shared-parent acceptance fixture plus back-edge/self-edge true-cycle rejects, preserving provenance order and no duplicate evidence inflation.

concerns.statement: B-AMB-01 is real but nonblocking for this review: multiple bound advisories name earlier proposal hashes and are constraints/history, not certifications of the current change bytes.
concerns.evidence: For example, the post-repair matrix and paper-value advisory identify proposal SHA-256 2fc2521d..., while the exact reviewed change is 1d4e9ca8.... The current proposal includes explicit v1, premortem, and pre-intake disposition ledgers, and both final independent interpretations plus this critique bind 1d4e9ca8.... Therefore older advisories may motivate obligations but cannot prove current-byte closure. T17 must review the post-ratification executable snapshot against the current ratified proposal and all current contract hashes, with no assertion that an older advisory's verdict carries forward automatically.

visibility_failures: The recurrent INPUT_ENVELOPE exposes only capability lists and the immediately preceding read result, not the workspace node bytes or accumulated read receipts that the model must use; an implicit transcript or KV path would be undeclared model-visible state.
The change graph sends PUBLIC_ACTOR output to a terminal node and contains no explicit public-next-state/action-validity return edge to TARGET_THINK for the remaining D4 USE operations.
target_menu_packet and ONE_SHOT_PLAN require model-visible target_id while private_field_registry and the change-level TARGET_THINK identity cell forbid target identity.
MODEL_READ_RESULT echoes the full model-authored query, but no taint or intervention test distinguishes immutable memory content from a query-carried agenda/scratchpad.

No current-byte issue was found that permits corpus, reader, digest, treatment, score, or LOCK data to enter PUBLIC_ACTOR directly once the stated split-process firewall is honored; the remaining actor defect is the missing authorized feedback route, not a direct corpus-to-actor edge.
missing_acceptance_tests: A recurrent-state visibility fixture must render the exact full next invocation after multiple node operations and both G04 reads, prove that every live workspace value and both opaque receipt refs are model-visible through one declared typed path, and reject hidden transcript/KV/history or unledgered bytes.

A four-step actor-feedback trace must bind an explicit PUBLIC_ACTOR public-next-state/action-validity edge back to TARGET_THINK or a named renderer, update action_ordinal/current tray/legal menu after each USE, and prove target truth, B, comparator, score, and evaluation cannot return on that edge.

A target-identity closure test must reconcile target_menu_packet and ONE_SHOT_PLAN with the registry/matrix: either prove a newly authorized opaque target label is treatment-invariant and answer-neutral at every Think boundary, or prove target_id is absent from all model-visible input and output bytes.

A query-to-agenda laundering suite must independently mutate or remove the echoed query while holding the selected NOTE/AST value and reader receipt fixed, separately mutate the memory value while holding query/status fixed, and report which channel changes citations and actions; query text must not count as retrieved evidence.

A provenance-graph suite must accept a valid diamond with shared ancestry and reject self-edges, back-edges, and true cycles using path-local cycle detection without counting synthetic re-expression as independent evidence.

A deterministic resource-forecast fixture must freeze the throughput source, estimator, workload match, device/context adjustment, safety margin, and pass/fail inequality for the 18-device-hour and 24-wall-hour stops; worst-case timeout accounting or any unverifiable forecast must return NOT_RUN.

If any future wording attributes later action to the Dream-2 replacement, add a separately deliberated h-crossed or retained-versus-replaced corpus mediation test; the current roster must instead lint such wording as forbidden.

If any future wording credits multi-hop Think path construction or memory-mechanism superiority, add direct dependency-chain/note-value interventions and fixed-budget raw-context, RAG, graph/A-MEM, reflection, and other relevant comparators; the current omitted cells remain NOT_RUN/non-comparative.
human_questions: Will the exact proposal be revised and rehashed before ratification so recurrent model input exposes its declared workspace and both G04 read receipts through a typed, token-accounted path with no hidden chat/KV state?
What exact graph edge returns actor public next state and action-validity to the same Think session between USE operations, and how is B/evaluation/score excluded from that edge?
Is target_id intended to be model-visible public input, contrary to the current registry and matrix, or will it be removed from target packets and ONE_SHOT_PLAN?
Will query echo be treated only as model-authored state rather than retrieved evidence, with a causal test separating query/status effects from NOTE/AST-value effects?

Does Rohin accept that compose and self-revision are labels only, while the earned descriptor is a nonsemantic branch-distinct REPLACE receipt plus a separate selected-h corpus-bundle action effect with no mediation?

Is final-action-only evaluation sufficient for this kill switch even though query quality, cited dependency chains, workspace reconstruction, and Dream-versus-reader-versus-prior credit remain unmeasured?

Does the decision owner accept that no comparator superiority, recurrence/efficiency, q specificity proof, Stage-2 replication, population effect, online learning, lifetime, LoRA, persistence, learned-control, or paper claim can follow from v2?
What frozen deterministic forecast rule and numerical safety margin will decide whether the exact 3,414-call roster fits 18 device-hours without silently changing hardware, runtime, tokens, or cells?
After proposal-byte repair and fresh consensus, does Rohin ratify only scoped implementation and Stage 0, preserving T17 and a separate exact pre-GPU approval before any scientific call?
